purpose: Path built from the sha only, never from an id.

title: clean_tmps

title: delete_blob

title: put_blob

purpose: Re-hash; True iff present and content matches its name.
title: verify_blob

purpose: Complete a possibly short POSIX write; a non-progressing write is an I/O failure.
title: write_all

FG is never touched (root set). Input
title: compact

purpose: Sole definition (gates.verify and ingest import it): sha256 over sorted FG ids, each newline-terminated.
title: fg_ids_sha256

purpose: FG_ids(n) subset of FG_ids(n+1); rc 5 E_GATE otherwise.
title: g_fg_monotone

purpose: Blob shas safe to delete: unreferenced by every generation in the rollback window and the dropping generation is durable (SPEC_VMEM §7, SW-0180 I3). window_gens: iterable of unit lists (<= VM_GEN_KEEP).
title: gc_plan

purpose: Every unit of every generation in [CURRENT-VM_GEN_KEEP+1, CURRENT] has all its blob_refs present.
title: _g_window

purpose: Remove *.tmp leftovers and gen dirs above the highest acknowledged gen. Returns removed names.
title: cleanup_unacked

purpose: Gen number CURRENT points to, or None for an empty store.
title: current_gen

purpose: CURRENT.tmp symlink -> os.replace(CURRENT) -> fsync store dir.
title: flip

purpose: Stage gen/<n>.tmp, fsync everything, rename to gen/<n>. Returns manifest sha256. files: {relpath: bytes}; a failure leaves gen/<n> absent.
title: publish_gen

purpose: SPEC_VMEM §2: gen/<n>/episodes/<run_id>.jsonl files of the parent generation are carried verbatim.
title: _carry_episodes

purpose: Normalize the §3.4 static-look carrier without requiring dirty-region fields.
title: _look_region

purpose: -> (run, episodes, regions, verdicts); every failure is E_SCHEMA/E_ID (rc 2/3) before anything is written.
title: parse_spool

purpose: Stage and commit generation n+1 from unit lists: catalogue, indexes and digest rebuilt; commit gates apply. `episodes` = {run_id: [episode dict]} added to the episodes carried over from the parent generation.
title: write_gen

purpose: Detect another writer or torn-tail repair without rereading sealed segments.
title: Journal._stamp

purpose: Append one hash-chained record, fsync, return it.
title: Journal.append

purpose: Newest compaction base {gen, seq, h} (VG-0219 C6 applied), or None.
title: Journal.base

purpose: Seal the chain at record `upto_seq`: write base_<gen>.json = {gen, seq, h}, fsync file and dir, then unlink sealed (non-last) segments whose records all have seq <= upto_seq. Returns the base or None if nothing to do.
title: Journal.checkpoint

purpose: Drop a torn tail line of the last segment; returns bytes dropped.
title: Journal.recover_torn

purpose: True iff seq is dense, prev links match and every h recomputes.
title: Journal.verify_chain

purpose: Acknowledge only complete writes; a zero write cannot make progress.
title: _write_all

purpose: receipt_sha256 of a unit = sha256 of runs/<run_id>/manifest.json.
title: receipt_sha256

purpose: Subtraction form (VG-0219 C3): no sum can wrap.
title: rotates

purpose: Reader pinned to one generation; every verb ends with snap.validate() (lock-free isolation).
title: View

purpose: Shortlist <= SHORTLIST_B canonical bytes; drops tail rows (overflow count); even one row too big -> rc 6.
title: _fit

purpose: verdict PASS; a GOLDEN baseline carries no verdict and counts as good.
title: _is_good

purpose: ~log2(num/den) in ppm, num >= den >= 1: bit_length + linear mantissa (deterministic, monotone).
title: _log2_ppm

purpose: Ladder V0 digest -> V1 shortlist -> V3 top unit -> V4 <= 2 crops. Levels are dropped from the bottom to fit max_tok; V0+V1 alone above ANSWER_HARD_TOK -> E_BUDGET rc 6.
title: answer

purpose: GOLDEN baselines of the tk plus its FG region_events carrying a look, ordered by (build_seq, id).
title: appearance_chain

title: build_sig_index

purpose: Every cite resolves in CURRENT (unit exists + cite among its anchors); every quote >= 12 chars is a substring of the unit's text fields (key, subject, summary, value). Failure -> NOT_IN_VISUAL_MEMORY reason check_failed (rc 3).
title: check_answer

purpose: First GOLDEN after the appearance at from_build whose look is DIFFERENT; bisect over build_seq, O(log G).
title: diff_region

purpose: Anchors + blob paths (built from sha only).
title: evidence

purpose: GOLDEN baselines of one tk ordered by (build_seq or ingest order, id).
title: golden_chain

purpose: -> 'SAME_EXACT' | 'SAME_NOISY' | 'DIFFERENT'; grid mismatch -> E_STALE (rc 4). One implementation: units.look_eq.
title: look_eq

purpose: V1 shortlist. Abstention first match wins: a scope, c build, d tk, e sig, f lexical (§8.3).
title: route

purpose: -> [(dist, unit_id)] sorted. Band index exact for d <= 3; scan=True: linear popcount over ids.bin up to d 4.
title: sig_lookup

purpose: Lock-free reader pinned to one generation (SPEC_VMEM §9: resolve CURRENT once, re-check at the end).
title: Snapshot

purpose: rc 4 if CURRENT moved or the manifest changed during the read.
title: Snapshot.validate

purpose: FX-GC2: delete generations below the rollback window [cur-VM_GEN_KEEP+1, cur], oldest first. Idempotent; a SIGKILL mid-rmtree leaves a gen outside the window that the next gc finishes (commit takes max(list_gens)+1).
title: Store._prune_gens

purpose: Write blobs, then gen n+1 with `files`, flip CURRENT, journal the flip. title: Store.commit

purpose: Checkpoint at the newest flip older than the rollback window (SPEC_VMEM §7, VG-0219 C6); None if none.
title: Store.compact_journal

purpose: Delete blobs outside the rollback-window union (computed here, SPEC_VMEM §7). A caller-supplied `referenced` may only add to the keep set; one missing a window ref -> rc 5 E_GATE g_window.
title: Store.gc_blobs

purpose: Units of generation n (active + archive); lenient by default (raw test gens are tolerated).
title: Store.gen_units

purpose: Non-blocking exclusive lock; held -> rc 4. Recovery runs under the lock.
title: Store.lock

purpose: Drop torn journal tail, unacked gens/tmp files; reconcile a durable CURRENT missing its flip record.
title: Store.recover

purpose: Repoint CURRENT to a generation inside the window [CURRENT-VM_GEN_KEEP+1, CURRENT].
title: Store.rollback

purpose: Return list of corrupt shas; quick samples the first 64 by sha order.
title: Store.verify_blobs

purpose: Blob shas that gc must keep: every blob_ref of every generation in [CURRENT-VM_GEN_KEEP+1, newest].
title: Store.window_refs

purpose: Published FG evidence is immutable; only last_gen and supported supersession may change.
title: _check_fg_edits

purpose: JSONL bytes -> unit list. strict: every line must be a valid vmem.unit/v1; lenient: skip bad lines.
title: _parse_units

purpose: Ingest is never refused for FG; non-FG growth beyond the cap is rc 6.
title: check_l2

purpose: g_catalogue: FG units <-> catalogue rows bijection (rc 5 E_GATE).
